note: Saved snapshots of public-domain classical texts used as sources (owner decision 2026-10-24: such a text counts as a verified source when the quote is checked against the saved snapshot, cited by chapter, not page). Each snapshot is the raw wikitext of the page as fetched; tools/book_text.py quote_on_page('WEB:<id>', '<section>', quote) searches the section whose wiki heading contains <section> (the whole file when the section is empty). Transcribed scans (no text layer) live in engine/data/sources_scan and are read the same way with 'SCAN:<id>' and the printed page number. Bát Tự snapshots (CTBG 穷通宝鉴, TBCT 子平真詮) are JSON files {chapters: [{chapter, text}]}: their section is the exact chapter title.
